narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our journey into the world of real numbers! In this video, we'll explore what real numbers are, why they're so fundamental in mathematics, and how they help us understand the continuous nature of our world. We'll also touch upon their key properties and how they are represented. Get ready to explore the fascinating world of real numbers and their properties, laying the groundwork for more advanced mathematical concepts.
